# ANALYSIS: BASELINE_EDGE_MEASUREMENT_J_ANCHORS

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the current engine's edge_capture on J's source-of-truth anchor days can be quantified via a Stage-1 backtest, and that OOS walk-forward and real-fills validation will confirm robustness. The goal is to measure edge_capture to ensure it exceeds the OP-16 floor of 771 before considering any modifications.

## Mechanism

Run a Stage-1 backtest of the current engine (no parameter or logic changes) over the full available history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using the existing params.json and aggressive/params.json as applicable. Compute engine_pnl on each of the six J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04 winners; 5/05, 5/06, 5/07 losers). Calculate edge_capture = sum(max(0, PnL on winner days)) - sum(max(0, -PnL on loser days)). Then conduct an OOS walk-forward test (e.g., 80/20 split by time) to verify stability, and finally run real-fills simulation (using cached OPRA data) on the top three J days to validate fill quality.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline edge_capture.
2. **Sample bias:** Sample consists of all available SPY 5m bars from 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 (~16 months). Selection is non-random (time-ordered), risk of overfit to recent regimes; OOS walk-forward will mitigate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA simulation on top 3 J days pending).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loser exceeding -$500; max drawdown could exceed 30% of equity; blow-up scenario if engine takes large losing positions on multiple loser days.
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, X will be disclosed after backtest; currently unknown.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: all existing tests must pass.
- Walk-forward OOS Sharpe ratio >= 0.70.
- Real-fills validation: simulated PnL on top 3 J days within ±20% of BS-sim estimates.
- OP-16 edge_capture >= 771.

## Confidence

5 / 10 -- Awaiting Stage-1 backtest results to ground truth.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis does not propose a change; it serves as a measurement baseline. It complements all existing candidates by providing the ground-truth edge_capture against which their delta can be assessed. No conflict.
